title: Ritual Summon L5-1
source: Port-authored setup from Tools/puzzles/generate_puzzles.py template 'ritual_summon', level 5, variant 1. The line uses engine-supported cards but is not a GBA fixed-board reconstruction.
notes: Ritual Summon Legendary Flame Lord with Incandescent Ordeal, then attack for exact LP.

canon_reference.setup_status: canon setup unavailable; this file uses a port-authored template
solution_steps: Normal Summon Theban Nightmare in attack mode.
Revive a second Theban Nightmare using Premature Burial.
Activate Emergency Provisions and tribute Premature Burial. Since it was not destroyed, but tributed, you will keep Theban Nightmare.
Use Smashing Ground against one of the Metal Armored Bugs.
Attack the second bug with Injection Fairy Lily, using her ATK boost, and the third one with a boosted Theban Nightmare.
Then attack directly with the rest of your monsters.
